steps.code:
# Fetch all songs from the library (use page_limit=20 to get as many as possible per call)
all_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total songs in library: {len(all_songs)}")
print("Song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in all_songs])
